To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
the crystal structure, particle plasticity and elastic deformation, and tablet tensile strength are not correlated for the investigated compounds.
the relationship between crystallographic structure, mechanical deformation properties, and compaction performance of PRA and its co-crystals and coformers cannot be established.
the structure–property–performance relationship could not be established for the investigated PRA and its derivatives.
In summary, our research is concerned with

the relationship between crystallographic structure, mechanical properties and tableting performance of paracetamolo, oxalic acid, paracetamol hydrochloride, paracetamolo-oxalic acid cocrystal and paracetamol-4,4'- bipyridine cocrystal.
the relationship between crystallographic structure of crystals and the ability of the crystals to be compressed into tablets.
the development of a new method of synthesis of a series of cocrystals of paracetamole with different coformers.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
the crystal structure and the particle deformation properties do not predict the tablet-forming performance.
the crystal structure does not explain the tablet-forming properties of PRA, PRAHCl, and PRA cocrystals and coformers.
crystallographic structure is not a good predictor for powder compression properties and tablet forming ability for PRA and cocrystal/salt.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the mechanical properties of PRA and its salt and cocrystals cannot explain their different tablet-forming ability, and that the crystallographic structure is not the only important factor in the structure-property-performance of PRA and related compounds.
we could not establish a relationship between crystal structure and mechanical properties.
we could not establish the relationship between crystal lattice structure, plasticity, elastic deformation, and tablet-formability.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the relationship between crystal lattice structure and mechanical properties is not as simple as it was thought to be.
it is important to understand the interparticle bonding in relation to crystal structure and particle deformation properties.
the crystallographic structure does not necessarily dictate the mechanical properties of the crystal, and that the mechanical properties do not necessarily dictate the tablet-forming properties.
